verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Zoho Invoice's API coverage, let alone parity with the UI's features (invoices, quotes, recurring billing, payments, reports, etc.). Probe-2 only shows that a Markdown version of an API v3 introduction path returned 404. The OpenAPI probes also failed, and the integrations claims (CRM, Books) are adjacent features that do not establish API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
